concepts.def: A chemical produced by a plant that coordinates and controls growth and the plant's responses to stimuli such as light and gravity.
The growth response of a plant to light. A shoot lit from one side bends towards the light because auxin is unequally distributed, giving unequal growth rates on the two sides.
The growth response of a plant to gravity. Roots grow towards gravity and shoots grow away from it, because auxin is unequally distributed and causes unequal growth rates.

A plant hormone whose unequal distribution causes unequal growth rates in plant roots and shoots. Where auxin collects in a shoot the growth rate increases; where it collects in a root the growth rate is reduced, so the shoot or root bends.
Plant hormones that are important in initiating seed germination.
A plant hormone that controls cell division and the ripening of fruits.

concepts.term: Commercial use of plant growth hormones
concepts.def: Plant growth hormones are used in agriculture and horticulture to control plant growth: auxins as weed killers, as rooting powders and for promoting growth in tissue culture; ethene in the food industry to control ripening of fruit during storage and transport; gibberellins to end seed dormancy, promote flowering and increase fruit size.

mcqs.q: A young shoot is lit from one side only and bends towards the light. Which explains this?
options: Auxin gathers on the lit side, which grows faster.
Auxin gathers on the shaded side, which grows less.
Auxin gathers on the shaded side, which grows faster.
Auxin gathers on the lit side, which then grows slower.
mcqs.explain: Unequal distribution of auxin gives more auxin on the shaded side of the shoot, which produces a faster growth rate on that side, so the shoot bends towards the light (phototropism).

mcqs.q: A seedling is laid on its side in the dark. Which describes the response of its root?
options: Auxin gathers on the lower side, which grows more quickly.
Auxin collects on the upper side, which grows slower.
Auxin gathers on the lower side, which grows slower.
Auxin gathers on the upper side, which then grows faster.
mcqs.explain: Unequal distribution of auxin gives more auxin on the lower side of the root, where it causes a slower growth rate, so the root bends downwards (gravitropism or geotropism).

mcqs.q: Which effect of a plant hormone is described correctly?
options: Gibberellins are important in initiating seed germination.
Ethene is important in initiating germination of seeds.
Gibberellins are important in maintaining seed dormancy.
Ethene is important in preventing the ripening of fruits.
mcqs.explain: This is the stated effect of gibberellins: they are important in initiating seed germination.

mcqs.q: A farmer sprays a field of cereal plants with a weed killer containing auxins. What is the result?
options: The weeds and the cereal crop are both killed off.
The weeds and the cereal crop both grow faster now.
The cereal dies and the weeds keep on growing.
The weeds die and the cereal crop keeps growing.
mcqs.explain: Auxins are used as weed killers in agriculture: the hormone upsets the growth of the weeds so that they die, while the cereal crop is unaffected.

mcqs.q: Bananas are picked unripe and kept cool while they are shipped. Ethene is used on them when they arrive. Why?
options: To stop the fruit from ripening while it is stored.
To start the fruit ripening at the end of storage.
To keep the fruit firm until it is in the shops.
To make the seeds inside the fruit start growing.
mcqs.explain: Ethene controls the ripening of fruits and is used in the food industry to control ripening during storage and transport, so the fruit ripens when it is wanted.

mcqs.q: A grower treats a fruit crop with gibberellins. Which result would be expected?
options: The fruits ripen early, before reaching full size.
The seeds inside the fruits are kept in dormancy.
The treated plants are killed off by the spray.
The fruits grow larger than untreated fruits.
mcqs.explain: Gibberellins can be used to increase fruit size, which is one of the ways plant growth hormones are used in agriculture and horticulture.
